const DAY_LABELS = ["DOM", "LUN", "MAR", "MER", "GIO", "VEN", "SAB"];

  "GEN", "FEB", "MAR", "APR", "MAG", "GIU",

];

function buildDays(count = 7) {
  const today = new Date();
  const list = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const d = new Date(today);
    d.setDate(today.getDate() + i);
    list.push({
      label: DAY_LABELS[d.getDay()],
      date: `${d.getDate()} ${MONTH_LABELS[d.getMonth()]}`,
      key: d.toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      dateObj: d,
      isToday: i === 0,
    });
  }
  return list;
}

  1: { morning: ["08:00", "09:00", "10:00", "11:00", "12:00", "13:00"], afternoon: ["17:00", "18:00", "19:00", "20:00"] },
  2: { morning: ["08:00", "09:00", "10:00", "11:00", "12:00", "13:00"], afternoon: ["17:00", "18:00", "19:00", "20:00"] },
  3: { morning: ["08:00", "09:00", "10:00", "11:00", "12:00", "13:00"], afternoon: ["17:00", "18:00", "19:00", "20:00"] },
  4: { morning: ["08:00", "09:00", "10:00", "11:00", "12:00", "13:00"], afternoon: ["17:00", "18:00", "19:00", "20:00"] },

  6: { morning: ["10:00", "11:00", "12:00"], afternoon: [] },   // Sabato 10–13
  0: { morning: [], afternoon: [] },                            // Domenica — chiuso
};

function getOpenBoxSlots(dayObj) {
  if (!dayObj) return { morning: [], afternoon: [] };
  return OPEN_BOX_BY_WEEKDAY[dayObj.dateObj.getDay()] || { morning: [], afternoon: [] };
}

function isClosedDay(dayObj) {
  if (!dayObj) return true;
  const slots = getOpenBoxSlots(dayObj);
  const classes = SCHEDULE_BY_WEEKDAY[dayObj.dateObj.getDay()] || [];
  return (
    classes.length === 0 &&
    slots.morning.length === 0 &&
    slots.afternoon.length === 0
  );
}

const CLASS_CAPACITY = 15;
const OPEN_BOX_CAPACITY = 10;

// posti occupati di esempio, generati in modo stabile per giorno+orario
function pseudoBooked(dateKey, time, max) {
  let hash = 0;
  const str = dateKey + time;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    hash = (hash * 31 + str.charCodeAt(i)) % 1000;
  }
  return hash % (max + 1);
}

function buildClassesForDay(dayObj) {
  if (!dayObj) return [];
  const times = SCHEDULE_BY_WEEKDAY[dayObj.dateObj.getDay()] || [];
  return times.map((time) => ({
    id: `${dayObj.key}-${time}`,
    time,
    type: "Functional",
    coach: "Coach",
    booked: pseudoBooked(dayObj.key, time, CLASS_CAPACITY),
    capacity: CLASS_CAPACITY,
  }));
}

const VARIANT_ORDER = ["RX", "SCALED", "OPEN"];

// restituisce le versioni disponibili per un WOD
function getVariants(wod) {
  if (!wod) return [];
  if (!wod.variants) return [];
  return VARIANT_ORDER.filter((v) => wod.variants[v]);
}

// ---------- Prenotazioni: orari, disdetta, lista d'attesa ----------

const CANCEL_LIMIT_MINUTES = 15;
const REMINDER_MINUTES = 60;

function classStartDate(dayObj, time) {
  if (!dayObj) return null;
  const [h, m] = time.split(":").map(Number);
  const d = new Date(dayObj.dateObj);
  d.setHours(h, m, 0, 0);
  return d;
}

// true se mancano più di 15 minuti all'inizio
function canCancel(dayObj, time) {
  const start = classStartDate(dayObj, time);
  if (!start) return true;
  return start.getTime() - Date.now() > CANCEL_LIMIT_MINUTES * 60 * 1000;
}

function minutesToStart(dayObj, time) {
  const start = classStartDate(dayObj, time);
  if (!start) return null;
  return Math.round((start.getTime() - Date.now()) / 60000);
}

function daysUntil(dateStr) {
  const d = parseItalianDate(dateStr);
  if (!d) return null;
  const today = new Date();
  today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  d.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  return Math.round((d - today) / 86400000);
}

// ---------- Calcolo carichi personali dalle percentuali ----------

const MONTH_ABBR_IT = {
  Gen: 0, Feb: 1, Mar: 2, Apr: 3, Mag: 4, Giu: 5,
  Lug: 6, Ago: 7, Set: 8, Ott: 9, Nov: 10, Dic: 11,
};

function parseItalianDate(str) {
  if (!str) return null;
  const m = String(str).match(/(\d{1,2})\s+(\w{3})\w*\s+(\d{4})/);
  if (!m) return null;
  const month = MONTH_ABBR_IT[m[2].slice(0, 3)];
  if (month === undefined) return null;
  return new Date(parseInt(m[3], 10), month, parseInt(m[1], 10));
}

function monthsSince(dateStr) {
  const d = parseItalianDate(dateStr);
  if (!d) return null;
  const now = new Date();
  return (now.getFullYear() - d.getFullYear()) * 12 + (now.getMonth() - d.getMonth());
}

// Formula di Epley: 1RM ≈ peso × (1 + ripetizioni / 30)
function estimateOneRm(weight, reps) {
  return weight * (1 + reps / 30);
}

// Trova il miglior riferimento per un movimento tra i PR registrati
function findOneRmFor(movement, records) {
  const exact = records.find((r) => r.name === movement);
  if (exact) {
    return {
      oneRm: exact.value,
      estimated: false,
      date: exact.date,
      source: movement,
    };
  }
  // cerca varianti tipo "Back Squat 3RM"
  const variants = records
    .map((r) => {
      const m = r.name.match(new RegExp(`^${movement} (\\d+)RM$`));
      return m ? { record: r, reps: parseInt(m[1], 10) } : null;
    })
    .filter(Boolean)
    .sort((a, b) => a.reps - b.reps);

  if (variants.length === 0) return null;
  const best = variants[0];
  return {
    oneRm: estimateOneRm(best.record.value, best.reps),
    estimated: true,
    date: best.record.date,
    source: best.record.name,
  };
}

function formatKg(n) {
  const rounded = Math.round(n * 10) / 10;
  return Number.isInteger(rounded) ? String(rounded) : rounded.toFixed(1);
}

const SCORE_CONFIG = {
  time: {
    label: "TEMPO",
    placeholder: "mm:ss",
    hint: "Formato minuti : secondi — es. 18:45",
    icon: Clock,
    suffix: "",
    sortAsc: true,
    keyboard: "numeric",
    // digita solo cifre, i due punti si inseriscono da soli
    format: (raw, prev) => {
      const digits = raw.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 5);
      if (digits.length === 0) return "";
      if (digits.length <= 2) return digits;
      const sec = digits.slice(-2);
      const min = digits.slice(0, -2);
      return `${min}:${sec}`;
    },
    validate: (v) => {
      if (!v) return "Inserisci il tuo tempo.";
      const m = v.match(/^(\d{1,3}):(\d{2})$/);
      if (!m) return "Usa il formato mm:ss (es. 18:45).";
      if (parseInt(m[2], 10) > 59) return "I secondi devono essere tra 00 e 59.";
      if (parseInt(m[1], 10) === 0 && parseInt(m[2], 10) === 0)
        return "Il tempo non può essere 00:00.";
      return null;
    },
  },
  reps: {
    label: "RIPETIZIONI TOTALI",
    placeholder: "Es. 245",
    hint: "Solo numeri interi",
    icon: TrendingUp,
    suffix: " reps",
    sortAsc: false,
    keyboard: "numeric",
    format: (raw) => raw.replace(/\D/g, "").slice(0, 4),
    validate: (v) => {
      if (!v) return "Inserisci le ripetizioni totali.";
      const n = parseInt(v, 10);
      if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n <= 0) return "Inserisci un numero valido.";
      return null;
    },
  },
  load: {
    label: "CARICO MASSIMO (KG)",
    placeholder: "Es. 120 oppure 122.5",
    hint: "Chilogrammi, con mezzo chilo se serve",
    icon: Dumbbell,
    suffix: " kg",
    sortAsc: false,
    keyboard: "decimal",
    format: (raw) => {
      let v = raw.replace(",", ".").replace(/[^\d.]/g, "");
      const parts = v.split(".");
      if (parts.length > 2) v = parts[0] + "." + parts.slice(1).join("");
      const [i, d] = v.split(".");
      return d !== undefined ? `${i.slice(0, 3)}.${d.slice(0, 1)}` : i.slice(0, 3);
    },
    validate: (v) => {
      if (!v) return "Inserisci il carico.";
      const n = parseFloat(v);
      if (!Number.isFinite(n) || n <= 0) return "Inserisci un peso valido.";
      if (n > 500) return "Controlla il valore: sembra troppo alto.";
      return null;
    },
  },
};

// ---------- Screens ----------

function ExpiryBanner({ expiry, kind, onAction }) {
  const days = daysUntil(expiry);
  const isCert = kind === "cert";
  // Il certificato richiede di prenotare una visita: preavviso lungo.
  // L'abbonamento si rinnova in reception in un minuto: bastano pochi giorni,
  // altrimenti su un mensile l'avviso resterebbe acceso per metà del periodo.
  const window = isCert ? 30 : 7;
  if (days === null || days > window) return null;
  const expired = days < 0;

  const title = expired
    ? isCert
      ? "Certificato medico scaduto"
      : "Abbonamento scaduto"
    : days === 0
    ? isCert
      ? "Il certificato medico scade oggi"
      : "Il tuo abbonamento scade oggi"
    : isCert
    ? `Il certificato medico scade tra ${days} giorni`
    : `Il tuo abbonamento scade tra ${days} giorni`;

  const body = expired
    ? isCert
      ? "Senza certificato valido non puoi prenotare. Portane uno nuovo in reception."
      : "Rinnova in reception per tornare ad allenarti e non perdere i tuoi progressi."
    : isCert
    ? "Porta il nuovo certificato in reception per continuare ad allenarti."
    : "Rinnova in reception per non interrompere il tuo percorso.";

  return (
    <button onClick={onAction} className="w-full text-left mb-3">
      <div
        className={`rounded-2xl border px-4 py-3.5 flex items-start gap-3 ${
          expired
            ? "border-neutral-500 bg-neutral-800"
            : "border-neutral-600 bg-neutral-900"
        }`}
      >
        {isCert ? (
          <Award size={18} className="text-neutral-200 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        ) : (
          <Clock size={18} className="text-neutral-200 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
        )}
        <div className="flex-1">
          <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-50 mb-0.5">
            {title}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 leading-relaxed">
            {body}
          </div>
        </div>
        <ChevronRight size={16} className="text-neutral-500 flex-shrink-0 mt-1" />
      </div>
    </button>
  );
}

                      {c.type.toUpperCase()}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-neutral-500 mt-0.5">
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Clock size={11} /> 60 min
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-neutral-700">|</span>
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1 truncate">
                        <User size={11} /> Coach
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right flex-shrink-0">
                    <div className="text-[13px] text-neutral-200 leading-none">
                      {c.booked}/{c.capacity}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500 mt-0.5">

                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => onOpenClass(c)}
                    className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-neutral-300 border border-neutral-800 rounded-lg py-2.5"
                  >
                    <User size={11} /> VEDI UTENTI
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (!isFull && !blocked) onToggleBook(c.id);
                    }}
                    disabled={isFull || (blocked && !isBooked)}
                    className={`flex-1 text-[11px] rounded-lg py-2.5 font-bold ${
                      isBooked
                        ? "border border-neutral-600 text-neutral-200"
                        : isFull || blocked
                        ? "bg-neutral-900 text-neutral-600 border border-neutral-800"
                        : "bg-neutral-50 text-black"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {isBooked
                      ? "PRENOTATO"
                      : isFull
                      ? "PIENO"
                      : blocked
                      ? "BLOCCATO"
                      : "BOOK"}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </Card>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

const PARTICIPANT_POOL = [
  "Luca Bianchi", "Giulia Rossi", "Marco Ferri", "Sara Conti", "Alessandro Villa",
  "Martina De Luca", "Davide Longo", "Elisa Romano", "Andrea Costa", "Francesca Greco",
  "Matteo Rinaldi", "Chiara Berti", "Simone Zen", "Paolo Rinaldi", "Valentina Moro",
  "Federico Neri", "Giorgia Fabbri", "Riccardo Testa", "Alice Ferrara", "Tommaso Bruno",
];

function getParticipantsForClass(classItem) {
  const key = String(classItem.id);
  let seed = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < key.length; i++) {
    seed = (seed * 31 + key.charCodeAt(i)) % 9973;
  }
  const count = Number(classItem.booked) || 0;
  const list = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    list.push(PARTICIPANT_POOL[(seed + i) % PARTICIPANT_POOL.length]);
  }
  return list;
}

const MONTHS_FULL_IT = [
  "gennaio", "febbraio", "marzo", "aprile", "maggio", "giugno",
  "luglio", "agosto", "settembre", "ottobre", "novembre", "dicembre",
];
const DAY_FULL_NAMES = {
  DOM: "Domenica", LUN: "Lunedì", MAR: "Martedì", MER: "Mercoledì",
  GIO: "Giovedì", VEN: "Venerdì", SAB: "Sabato",
};

function formatFullDate(selectedDay) {
  const dayObj = DAYS.find((d) => d.date === selectedDay);
  if (!dayObj) return selectedDay;
  const dayFull = DAY_FULL_NAMES[dayObj.label] || dayObj.label;
  const monthFull = MONTHS_FULL_IT[dayObj.dateObj.getMonth()];
  return `${dayFull} ${dayObj.dateObj.getDate()} ${monthFull}`;
}

function addMinutesToTime(timeStr, minutes) {
  const [h, m] = timeStr.split(":").map(Number);
  const total = h * 60 + m + minutes;
  const newH = Math.floor(total / 60) % 24;
  const newM = total % 60;
  return `${String(newH).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(newM).padStart(2, "0")}`;
}

function ClassDetailScreen({
  classItem,
  selectedDay,
  isBooked,
  isWaiting,
  waitlistPosition,
  onToggleBook,
  onToggleWaitlist,
  onBack,
}) {
  if (!classItem) return null;
  const dayObj = DAYS.find((d) => d.date === selectedDay);
  const isFull = classItem.booked >= classItem.capacity && !isBooked;
  const participants = getParticipantsForClass(classItem);
  const spotsLeft = Math.max(0, classItem.capacity - classItem.booked);
  const bookingBlocks = getBookingBlocks(dayObj ? dayObj.dateObj : null);
  const blocked = bookingBlocks.length > 0;
  const cancellable = canCancel(dayObj, classItem.time);
  const minsLeft = minutesToStart(dayObj, classItem.time);
  const isPast = minsLeft !== null && minsLeft < 0;

  // coda simulata: chi è già in lista prima di te
  const queueBase = isFull ? getParticipantsForClass({ ...classItem, id: classItem.id + "-q", booked: 2 }) : [];
  const queue = isWaiting ? [...queueBase, `${USER.name} (tu)`] : queueBase;

  return (
    <div className="px-5 pb-28 pt-1">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-5">
        <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full border border-neutral-700 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
          <Dumbbell size={22} className="text-neutral-300" />
        </div>
        <div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-display font-black text-neutral-50 leading-tight">
            {classItem.type.toUpperCase()}
          </div>
          <div className="text-neutral-500 text-sm mb-1">
            {formatFullDate(selectedDay)}
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-neutral-400 text-xs flex-wrap">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <Clock size={12} /> {classItem.time} – {addMinutesToTime(classItem.time, 60)}
            </span>
            <span>|</span>
            <span>60 min</span>
            <span>|</span>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
              <User size={12} /> {classItem.coach}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Card className="mb-4 flex items-center">
        <div className="flex-1 flex items-center gap-3">
          <User size={18} className="text-neutral-400" />
          <div>
            <div className="text-xl font-display font-black text-neutral-50">
              {classItem.booked}{" "}
              <span className="text-neutral-600 text-base font-medium">
                / {classItem.capacity}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-500">prenotati</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="w-px self-stretch bg-neutral-800 mx-3" />
        <div className="flex-1 text-center">
          <div className="text-xl font-display font-black text-neutral-50">
            {spotsLeft}
          </div>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-500">posti disponibili</div>
        </div>
      </Card>

      {isBooked && (
        <Card className="mb-4 flex items-start gap-3">
          <Check size={16} className="text-neutral-200 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" strokeWidth={3} />
          <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 leading-relaxed">
            {isPast ? (
              <>Questa classe è già iniziata.</>
            ) : cancellable ? (
              <>
                Sei prenotato. Puoi disdire fino a {CANCEL_LIMIT_MINUTES} minuti
                prima dell'inizio.
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                Mancano meno di {CANCEL_LIMIT_MINUTES} minuti all'inizio: non è
                più possibile disdire. Avvisa lo staff se non puoi venire.
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}

      {isWaiting && (
        <Card className="mb-4 flex items-start gap-3">
          <Clock size={16} className="text-neutral-300 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 leading-relaxed">
            Sei in lista d'attesa, posizione{" "}
            <span className="text-neutral-50 font-semibold">
              {waitlistPosition}
            </span>
            . Se si libera un posto entri in automatico e ricevi una notifica.
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}

      <div className="text-xs tracking-[0.15em] text-neutral-400 font-semibold mb-4">
        ATTIVI
      </div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-x-2 gap-y-5 mb-8">
        {participants.map((name, i) => (
          <div key={i} className="flex flex-col items-center text-center">
            <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full border border-neutral-700 flex items-center justify-center mb-2">
              <User size={22} className="text-neutral-400" />
            </div>
            <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-200 leading-tight">
              {name.split(" ").map((part, j) => (
                <div key={j}>{part}</div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="h-px bg-neutral-800 mb-6" />

      <div className="text-xs tracking-[0.15em] text-neutral-500 font-semibold mb-6">
        IN CODA {queue.length > 0 && `(${queue.length})`}
      </div>
      {queue.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-x-2 gap-y-5 mb-8">
          {queue.map((name, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="flex flex-col items-center text-center">
              <div className="relative">
                <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full border border-neutral-800 flex items-center justify-center mb-2 opacity-60">
                  <User size={22} className="text-neutral-500" />
                </div>
                <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-neutral-800 border border-neutral-700 text-[9px] text-neutral-300 flex items-center justify-center">
                  {i + 1}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 leading-tight">
                {name.split(" ").map((part, j) => (
                  <div key={j}>{part}</div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center py-4 mb-8">
          <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full border border-neutral-700 flex items-center justify-center mb-4">
            <User size={22} className="text-neutral-500" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-neutral-500 text-sm">
            Nessun elemento presente
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {isPast ? (
        <div className="w-full rounded-xl py-3.5 font-bold text-sm text-center bg-neutral-900 text-neutral-600 border border-neutral-800">
          CLASSE TERMINATA
        </div>
      ) : isBooked ? (
        <button
          disabled={!cancellable}
          onClick={() => onToggleBook(classItem.id)}
          className={`w-full rounded-xl py-3.5 font-bold text-sm ${
            cancellable
              ? "border border-neutral-700 text-neutral-200"
              : "bg-neutral-900 text-neutral-600 border border-neutral-800"
          }`}
        >
          {cancellable
            ? "ANNULLA PRENOTAZIONE"
            : `DISDETTA CHIUSA (${CANCEL_LIMIT_MINUTES} MIN PRIMA)`}
        </button>
      ) : blocked ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-neutral-600 bg-neutral-900 px-4 py-3.5 flex items-start gap-3">
          <Lock size={17} className="text-neutral-200 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <div>
            <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-50 mb-0.5">
              {bookingBlocks[0].title}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 leading-relaxed">
              {bookingBlocks[0].message}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : isWaiting ? (
        <button
          onClick={() => onToggleWaitlist(classItem.id)}
          className="w-full rounded-xl py-3.5 font-bold text-sm border border-neutral-700 text-neutral-200"
        >
          ESCI DALLA LISTA D'ATTESA
        </button>
      ) : isFull ? (
        <button
          onClick={() => onToggleWaitlist(classItem.id)}
          className="w-full rounded-xl py-3.5 font-bold text-sm bg-neutral-100 text-black"
        >
          ENTRA IN LISTA D'ATTESA
        </button>
      ) : (
        <button
          onClick={() => onToggleBook(classItem.id)}
          className="w-full rounded-xl py-3.5 font-bold text-sm bg-neutral-100 text-black"
        >
          PRENOTA CLASSE
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function OpenBoxScreen({ selectedDay, bookedSlots, onConfirm, onBack }) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(bookedSlots || []);
  const obBlocks = getBookingBlocks(
    DAYS.find((d) => d.date === selectedDay)?.dateObj || null,
    "openbox"
  );
  const dayObj = DAYS.find((d) => d.date === selectedDay);
  const slots = getOpenBoxSlots(dayObj);

  function takenFor(time) {
    return pseudoBooked(dayObj ? dayObj.key : "", time, OPEN_BOX_CAPACITY);
  }

  function toggleSlot(time) {
    const taken = takenFor(time);
    const alreadyBooked = (bookedSlots || []).includes(time);
    if (taken >= OPEN_BOX_CAPACITY && !alreadyBooked) return;
    setSelected((prev) =>
      prev.includes(time) ? prev.filter((t) => t !== time) : [...prev, time]
    );
  }

  function renderSlotGroup(label, slots) {
    return (
      <div className="mb-6">
        <div className="text-xs tracking-[0.15em] text-neutral-400 font-semibold mb-3">
          {label}
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">
          {slots.map((time) => {
            const taken = takenFor(time);
            const isFull = taken >= OPEN_BOX_CAPACITY;
            const isSelected = selected.includes(time);
            const wasBooked = (bookedSlots || []).includes(time);
            return (
              <button
                key={time}
                onClick={() => toggleSlot(time)}
                disabled={isFull && !wasBooked}
                className={`w-full rounded-2xl border p-3.5 flex items-center justify-between ${
                  isSelected
                    ? "border-neutral-50 bg-neutral-50/10"
                    : isFull
                    ? "border-neutral-900 bg-neutral-950 opacity-50"
                    : "border-neutral-800 bg-neutral-900/70"
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div
                    className={`w-5 h-5 rounded-md border flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 ${
                      isSelected
                        ? "bg-neutral-50 border-neutral-50"
                        : "border-neutral-600"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {isSelected && (
                      <Check size={12} className="text-black" strokeWidth={3} />
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-left">
                    <div className="text-base font-semibold text-neutral-50">
                      {time} – {addMinutesToTime(time, 60)}
                    </div>
                    {wasBooked && (
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400">
                        Già prenotato
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-100">
                    {taken} / {OPEN_BOX_CAPACITY}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500">
                    {isFull ? "pieno" : "posti"}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="px-5 pb-32 pt-1">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
        <Lock size={24} className="text-neutral-300" strokeWidth={1.5} />
        <div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-display font-black text-neutral-50">
            OPEN BOX
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs text-neutral-500">
            {formatFullDate(selectedDay)}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      {obBlocks.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="rounded-2xl border border-neutral-500 bg-neutral-800 px-4 py-3.5 mb-6 flex items-start gap-3">
          <Lock size={17} className="text-neutral-200 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <div>
            <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-50 mb-0.5">
              {obBlocks[0].title}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 leading-relaxed">
              {obBlocks[0].message}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="text-xs text-neutral-400 mb-6 leading-relaxed">
          Scegli una o più fasce orarie. Puoi selezionare anche orari non
          consecutivi.
        </div>
      )}

      {slots.morning.length === 0 && slots.afternoon.length === 0 && (
        <Card className="flex flex-col items-center text-center py-8 mb-6">
          <Lock size={24} className="text-neutral-600 mb-3" />
          <div className="text-sm text-neutral-400">
            Open Box non disponibile
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs text-neutral-600 mt-1">
            Il box è chiuso in questo giorno.
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}
      {slots.morning.length > 0 && renderSlotGroup("MATTINA", slots.morning)}
      {slots.afternoon.length > 0 && renderSlotGroup("POMERIGGIO", slots.afternoon)}

      <div className="fixed" />
      <div className="mt-2">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3 text-sm">
          <span className="text-neutral-400">Fasce selezionate</span>
          <span className="text-neutral-50 font-semibold">
            {selected.length}
          </span>
        </div>
        <button
          disabled={selected.length === 0 || obBlocks.length > 0}
          onClick={() => onConfirm(selected)}
          className={`w-full rounded-xl py-3.5 font-bold text-sm ${
            selected.length === 0 || obBlocks.length > 0
              ? "bg-neutral-900 text-neutral-600 border border-neutral-800"
              : "bg-neutral-50 text-black"
          }`}
        >
          {selected.length === 0
            ? "SELEZIONA UNA FASCIA"
            : `CONFERMA ${selected.length} ${
                selected.length === 1 ? "FASCIA" : "FASCE"
              }`}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

    { name: "Luca F.", score: "17:21", type: "SCALED" },

    { name: "Simone Z.", score: "18:45", type: "RX" },

  ],
  reps: [
    { name: "Marco B.", score: "312", type: "RX" },
    { name: "Sara M.", score: "298", type: "RX" },
    { name: "Giulia R.", score: "265", type: "SCALED" },
    { name: "Luca F.", score: "241", type: "SCALED" },
    { name: "Anna P.", score: "210", type: "OPEN" },
  ],
  load: [
    { name: "Marco B.", score: "150", type: "RX" },

    { name: "Giulia R.", score: "85", type: "SCALED" },
  ],
};

function scoreToNumber(value, scoreType) {
  if (scoreType === "time") {
    const parts = String(value).split(":").map((n) => parseInt(n, 10) || 0);
    if (parts.length === 2) return parts[0] * 60 + parts[1];
    return parts[0] || 0;
  }
  return parseFloat(String(value).replace(",", ".")) || 0;
}

function PersonalLoads({ loadBlocks, prRecords, onGoToPr }) {
  if (!loadBlocks || loadBlocks.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <Card className="mb-3 !p-0 overflow-hidden">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3.5 border-b border-neutral-800">
        <Lock size={14} className="text-neutral-500 flex-shrink-0" />
        <div className="flex-1">
          <div className="text-[15px] font-bold text-neutral-50">
            I TUOI CARICHI
          </div>
          <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500">
            Calcolati sui tuoi PR · visibili solo a te
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {loadBlocks.map((b, i) => {
        const ref = findOneRmFor(b.movement, prRecords);
        const age = ref ? monthsSince(ref.date) : null;
        const isOld = age !== null && age > 6;

        return (
          <div
            key={i}
            className={`px-4 py-3.5 ${
              i !== loadBlocks.length - 1 ? "border-b border-neutral-800" : ""
            }`}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
              <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-50">
                {b.movement}
              </div>
              <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400">
                {b.sets}x{b.reps} @ {b.percent}%
              </div>
            </div>

            {ref ? (
              <>
                <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2 mt-1.5">
                  <span className="text-2xl font-display font-black text-neutral-50">
                    {formatKg((ref.oneRm * b.percent) / 100)}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-sm text-neutral-400">kg</span>
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500 mt-1.5 leading-relaxed">
                  {b.percent}% di {formatKg(ref.oneRm)} kg
                  {ref.estimated ? (
                    <> — 1RM stimato dal tuo {ref.source}</>
                  ) : (
                    <> — tuo 1RM</>
                  )}{" "}
                  ({ref.date})
                </div>
                {ref.estimated && (
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-600 mt-1">
                    Valore stimato: verifica che sia adatto a te.
                  </div>
                )}
                {isOld && (
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-1.5 mt-2 bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2">
                    <Clock size={11} className="text-neutral-500 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 leading-relaxed">
                      Questo PR ha più di 6 mesi. Valuta con il coach se il
                      carico è ancora adatto.
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </>
            ) : (
              <div className="mt-2">
                <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-500 mb-2">
                  Non hai ancora un PR per questo movimento.
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={onGoToPr}
                  className="text-[11px] font-semibold border border-neutral-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-neutral-200"
                >
                  + Aggiungi il tuo PR
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </Card>
  );
}

function WodScreen({ selectedDay, onSelectDay, myScores, onSaveScore, defaultShare, prRecords, onGoToPr }) {
  const wod = WOD_WEEK[selectedDay];
  const scoreType = wod ? wod.scoreType : "time";
  const config = SCORE_CONFIG[scoreType];
  const existing = myScores[selectedDay];

  const dayIsClosed = isClosedDay(DAYS.find((d) => d.date === selectedDay));
  const variants = getVariants(wod);
  const [variant, setVariant] = useState(
    existing && existing.type ? existing.type : variants[0] || "RX"
  );
  const activeVariant = wod && wod.variants ? wod.variants[variant] : null;
  const blocks = activeVariant ? activeVariant.blocks : [];
  const loadBlocks = activeVariant ? activeVariant.loadBlocks : null;
  const [scoreValue, setScoreValue] = useState(existing ? existing.score : "");
  const [share, setShare] = useState(
    existing ? existing.share : defaultShare
  );
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("Tutti");
  const [touched, setTouched] = useState(false);

  const error = config.validate(scoreValue);

  const saved = Boolean(existing) && existing.score === scoreValue;

  const allScores = [
    ...(COMMUNITY_SCORES[scoreType] || []),
    ...(existing && existing.share
      ? [
          {
            name: `${USER.name} (tu)`,
            score: existing.score,
            type: existing.type,
            isMe: true,
          },
        ]
      : []),
  ];

  const filteredScores = allScores
    .filter((s) => filter === "Tutti" || s.type === filter)
    .sort((a, b) => {
      const na = scoreToNumber(a.score, scoreType);
      const nb = scoreToNumber(b.score, scoreType);
      return config.sortAsc ? na - nb : nb - na;
    });

  const InputIcon = config.icon;

  return (
    <div className="px-5 pb-28 pt-1">
      <div className="text-3xl font-display font-black text-neutral-50 mb-1">
        WOD
      </div>
      <div className="text-sm text-neutral-500 mb-5">
        Allenati. Misurati. Migliora.
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1 -mx-1 px-1 mb-5">
        {DAYS.map((d) => {
          const isActive = d.date === selectedDay;
          const hasWod = Boolean(WOD_WEEK[d.date]);
          const [num, month] = d.date.split(" ");
          return (
            <button
              key={d.date}
              onClick={() => onSelectDay(d.date)}
              className={`flex-shrink-0 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-center border min-w-[54px] ${
                isActive
                  ? "bg-neutral-100 border-neutral-100"
                  : "bg-neutral-900/70 border-neutral-800"
              }`}
            >
              <div
                className={`text-sm font-semibold ${
                  isActive ? "text-black" : "text-neutral-300"
                }`}
              >
                {d.label}
              </div>
              <div
                className={`text-[10px] whitespace-nowrap leading-tight mt-0.5 ${
                  isActive ? "text-neutral-700" : "text-neutral-500"
                }`}
              >
                {num} {month}
              </div>
              <div
                className={`w-1 h-1 rounded-full mx-auto mt-1 ${
                  hasWod
                    ? isActive
                      ? "bg-black"
                      : "bg-neutral-500"
                    : "bg-transparent"
                }`}
              />
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {wod ? (
        <>
          <Card className="mb-3 !p-0 overflow-hidden">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3.5 border-b border-neutral-800">
              <div className="text-[15px] font-bold text-neutral-50">
                WOD DI OGGI
              </div>
              <div className="w-px h-4 bg-neutral-700" />
              <div className="text-[15px] text-neutral-400 tracking-wide">
                FUNCTIONAL
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="p-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3 gap-2">
                <span className="inline-block text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-wide bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-200 rounded px-2.5 py-1">
                  {wod.title}
                </span>
                {variants.length > 1 && (
                  <div className="flex gap-1 bg-neutral-950 rounded-lg p-1">
                    {variants.map((v) => (
                      <button
                        key={v}
                        onClick={() => setVariant(v)}
                        className={`text-[10px] font-bold rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 ${
                          variant === v
                            ? "bg-neutral-100 text-black"
                            : "text-neutral-400"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {v}
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="font-display font-black text-neutral-50 text-2xl leading-snug mb-4">
                {blocks.map((b, i) => (
                  <div key={i}>{b.toUpperCase()}</div>

              {wod.cap && (

              {variants.map((t) => (

                  key={t}

                  className={`flex-1 rounded-lg py-2.5 text-xs font-bold ${
                    variant === t
                      ? "bg-neutral-100 text-black"

                >

            <div className="flex gap-2.5 mb-2">

                className={`flex-1 flex items-center gap-2 bg-neutral-950 border rounded-xl px-3 py-3 ${

                }`}
              >
                <InputIcon size={15} className="text-neutral-500 flex-shrink-0" />
                <input
                  value={scoreValue}

            <div className="text-[10px] mb-3 min-h-[14px]">

                />

                <div className="text-[12px] text-neutral-200">
                  {share
                    ? "Visibile nella classifica"
                    : "Score privato"}

                <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500">
                  {share
                    ? "Gli altri soci vedranno il tuo risultato."
                    : "Solo tu vedrai questo risultato."}
                </div>
              </div>
              {!share && <Lock size={13} className="text-neutral-500" />}
            </button>
          </Card>

          <Card className="!p-0 overflow-hidden">
            <div className="px-4 pt-4 pb-3">
              <div className="text-[15px] font-bold text-neutral-50 mb-3">
                SCORE DELLA COMMUNITY
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                {["Tutti", ...variants].map((f) => (
                  <button
                    key={f}
                    onClick={() => setFilter(f)}
                    className={`rounded-lg px-4 py-2 text-[11px] font-semibold ${
                      filter === f
                        ? "bg-neutral-100 text-black"
                        : "bg-neutral-950 text-neutral-400 border border-neutral-800"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {f}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            {existing && !existing.share && (
              <div className="mx-4 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2.5 bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5">
                <Lock size={13} className="text-neutral-500 flex-shrink-0" />
                <div className="flex-1 text-[11px] text-neutral-400">
                  Il tuo score{" "}
                  <span className="text-neutral-100 font-semibold">
                    {existing.score}
                    {config.suffix}
                  </span>{" "}
                  è privato
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
            <div>
              {filteredScores.map((s, i) => (
                <div
                  key={i}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 border-t border-neutral-800 ${
                    s.isMe ? "bg-neutral-50/5" : ""
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="text-sm text-neutral-500 w-3 flex-shrink-0">
                    {i + 1}
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-neutral-800 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
                    <User size={15} className="text-neutral-400" />
                  </div>
                  <div
                    className={`flex-1 text-sm ${
                      s.isMe
                        ? "text-neutral-50 font-semibold"
                        : "text-neutral-100"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {s.name}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-50">
                    {s.score}
                    {config.suffix}
                  </div>
                  <span
                    className={`text-[10px] font-bold rounded px-2.5 py-1.5 flex-shrink-0 ${
                      s.type === "RX"
                        ? "bg-neutral-200 text-black"
                        : s.type === "SCALED"
                        ? "bg-neutral-700 text-neutral-100"
                        : "bg-neutral-900 text-neutral-400 border border-neutral-700"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {s.type}
                  </span>
                </div>
              ))}
              {filteredScores.length === 0 && (
                <div className="px-4 py-6 text-center text-sm text-neutral-500 border-t border-neutral-800">
                  Nessuno score in questa categoria.
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </Card>
        </>
      ) : (
        <Card className="flex flex-col items-center text-center py-10">
          <Dumbbell size={26} className="text-neutral-600 mb-3" />
          <div className="text-sm text-neutral-400">
            {dayIsClosed ? "Box chiuso" : "Nessun WOD pubblicato"}
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs text-neutral-600 mt-1 px-6 leading-relaxed">
            {dayIsClosed
              ? "In questo giorno il box è chiuso, quindi non è previsto nessun WOD."
              : "Il coach non ha ancora caricato il workout di questo giorno."}
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function LineChart({ values, height = 90 }) {
  if (!values || values.length === 0) return null;
  const max = Math.max(...values);
  const min = Math.min(...values);
  const range = max - min || 1;
  const w = 100;
  const points = values.map((v, i) => {
    const x = (i / (values.length - 1)) * w;
    const y = height - ((v - min) / range) * (height - 12) - 6;
    return { x, y };
  });
  const path = points
    .map((p, i) => `${i === 0 ? "M" : "L"} ${p.x} ${p.y}`)
    .join(" ");
  return (
    <svg
      viewBox={`0 0 ${w} ${height}`}
      preserveAspectRatio="none"
      className="w-full"
      style={{ height }}
    >
      <path d={path} fill="none" stroke="#f5f5f5" strokeWidth="1.2" vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke" />
      {points.map((p, i) => (
        <circle key={i} r="1.6" cx={p.x} cy={p.y} fill="#f5f5f5" vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke" />
      ))}
    </svg>
  );
}

function DonutChart({ percent, size = 92 }) {
  const stroke = 12;
  const radius = (size - stroke) / 2;
  const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
  const filled = (percent / 100) * circumference;
  return (
    <svg width={size} height={size} className="flex-shrink-0">
      <circle
        cx={size / 2}
        cy={size / 2}
        r={radius}
        fill="none"
        stroke="#3f3f46"
        strokeWidth={stroke}
      />
      <circle
        cx={size / 2}
        cy={size / 2}
        r={radius}
        fill="none"
        stroke="#f5f5f5"
        strokeWidth={stroke}
        strokeDasharray={`${filled} ${circumference - filled}`}
        strokeLinecap="round"
        transform={`rotate(-90 ${size / 2} ${size / 2})`}
      />
    </svg>
  );
}

        ))}
      </Card>
    </>
  );
}

const PERIODS = ["Ultimo mese", "Ultimi 3 mesi", "Ultimi 12 mesi"];
const TREND_BY_PERIOD = {
  "Ultimo mese": { values: [66, 68, 70, 71, 74], labels: ["S1", "S2", "S3", "S4"], percent: 74, delta: "+4%" },
  "Ultimi 3 mesi": { values: [42, 48, 52, 56, 58, 63, 66, 68, 71, 74], labels: ["Lug", "Ago", "Set"], percent: 74, delta: "+12%" },
  "Ultimi 12 mesi": { values: [28, 33, 38, 41, 45, 48, 52, 57, 61, 65, 69, 74], labels: ["Ott", "Gen", "Apr", "Lug", "Set"], percent: 74, delta: "+46%" },
};

function ProgressWod({ onOpen, benchmarks }) {
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState("Ultimi 3 mesi");
  const [periodOpen, setPeriodOpen] = useState(false);
  const trend = TREND_BY_PERIOD[period];

  return (
    <>
      <Card className="mb-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
          <div className="text-xs tracking-[0.12em] text-neutral-300 font-semibold">
            TREND RX
          </div>
          <div className="relative">
            <button
              onClick={() => setPeriodOpen((v) => !v)}
              className="text-[11px] text-neutral-200 border border-neutral-700 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5"
            >
              {period}
              <ChevronDown size={12} className="text-neutral-500" />
            </button>
            {periodOpen && (
              <div className="absolute right-0 top-9 z-20 bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-700 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-xl w-36">
                {PERIODS.map((p) => (
                  <button
                    key={p}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setPeriod(p);
                      setPeriodOpen(false);
                    }}
                    className={`block w-full text-left px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[11px] ${
                      period === p
                        ? "bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-50"
                        : "text-neutral-300"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {p}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className="flex-1">
            <LineChart values={trend.values} height={90} />
            <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-neutral-600 mt-1">
              {trend.labels.map((l) => (
                <span key={l}>{l}</span>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-right flex-shrink-0">
            <div className="text-2xl font-display font-black text-neutral-50">
              {trend.percent}%
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-400 leading-tight">
              WOD RX
              <br />
              <span className="text-neutral-600">nell'ultimo mese</span>
            </div>
            <span className="inline-block mt-2 text-[10px] font-semibold bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-200 rounded px-2 py-1">
              {trend.delta} ↑
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card className="mb-3">
        <div className="text-xs tracking-[0.12em] text-neutral-300 font-semibold mb-4">
          TIPO DI SCORE
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <DonutChart percent={PROGRESS_WOD.rxShare} />
          <div className="flex-1">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-neutral-100" />
              <span className="text-sm text-neutral-200">
                {PROGRESS_WOD.rxShare}% RX
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-neutral-600" />
              <span className="text-sm text-neutral-400">
                {PROGRESS_WOD.scaledShare}% SCALED
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-center border-l border-neutral-800 pl-4">
            <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500 mb-1">Totale WOD</div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-display font-black text-neutral-50">
              {PROGRESS_WOD.totalWod}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[9px] text-neutral-600 leading-tight mt-0.5">
              negli ultimi
              <br />3 mesi
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card className="mb-3 !p-0 overflow-hidden">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-3.5">
          <div className="text-xs tracking-[0.12em] text-neutral-300 font-semibold">
            ULTIMI SCORE
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => onOpen("scores")}
            className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 flex items-center gap-0.5"
          >
            Vedi tutti <ChevronRight size={12} />
          </button>
        </div>
        {PROGRESS_WOD.lastScores.map((s, i) => (
          <button
            key={i}
            onClick={() => onOpen("scores")}
            className="w-full text-left flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 border-t border-neutral-800"
          >
            <div className="bg-neutral-800 rounded-md px-2 py-1.5 text-center flex-shrink-0 w-12">
              <div className="text-[9px] text-neutral-400">{s.day}</div>

                {s.score}

              <span
                className={`inline-block mt-1 text-[9px] font-bold rounded px-2 py-1 ${
                  s.type === "RX"
                    ? "bg-neutral-300 text-black"
                    : "bg-neutral-700 text-neutral-200"
                }`}
              >
                {s.type}
              </span>
            </div>
            <ChevronRight size={14} className="text-neutral-600 flex-shrink-0" />
          </button>
        ))}
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
          <div className="text-xs tracking-[0.12em] text-neutral-300 font-semibold">
            BENCHMARK
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={() => onOpen("benchmark")}
            className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 flex items-center gap-0.5"
          >
            Vedi tutti <ChevronRight size={12} />
          </button>
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
          {benchmarks.slice(0, 2).map((b) => (
            <div
              key={b.name}
              className="bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl p-3"
            >
              <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-50 mb-1">
                {b.name}
              </div>
              <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500 mb-1.5">
                Miglior score
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
                <span className="text-lg font-display font-black text-neutral-50">
                  {b.score}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-neutral-600">{b.date}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </Card>
    </>
  );
}

function SearchableLibrary({
  library,
  isGrouped,
  onSelect,
  selectedName,
  placeholder,
  onAddCustom,
  customLabel,
}) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();

  const filtered = library
    .map((section) => ({
      group: section.group,
      items: section.items.filter((item) => {
        const label = typeof item === "string" ? item : item.name;
        return label.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      }),
    }))
    .filter((section) => section.items.length > 0);

  const noResults = filtered.length === 0;

  return (
    <>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl px-3 py-3 mb-3">
        <Search size={15} className="text-neutral-500 flex-shrink-0" />
        <input
          value={query}
          onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          className="bg-transparent text-sm text-neutral-100 placeholder-neutral-600 outline-none w-full"
        />
        {query && (
          <button onClick={() => setQuery("")} className="text-neutral-500">
            <X size={14} />
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="max-h-52 overflow-y-auto mb-3 -mx-1 px-1">
        {filtered.map((section) => (
          <div key={section.group} className="mb-3">
            <div className="text-[9px] tracking-widest text-neutral-600 mb-2">
              {section.group.toUpperCase()}
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
              {section.items.map((item) => {
                const label = typeof item === "string" ? item : item.name;
                const isSel = selectedName === label;
                return (
                  <button
                    key={label}
                    onClick={() => onSelect(item)}
                    className={`text-[11px] rounded-lg px-2.5 py-2 font-medium ${
                      isSel
                        ? "bg-neutral-100 text-black font-semibold"
                        : "bg-neutral-900 text-neutral-300 border border-neutral-800"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {label}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}

        {noResults && (
          <div className="text-center py-4">
            <div className="text-xs text-neutral-500 mb-3">
              Nessun risultato per "{query}"
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => onAddCustom(query)}
              className="text-[11px] font-semibold border border-neutral-600 border-dashed rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-neutral-200"
            >
              {customLabel} "{query}"
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

const PR_EXERCISES = [
  "Back Squat", "Front Squat", "Deadlift", "Bench Press",
  "Clean", "Snatch", "Clean & Jerk", "Strict Press",
];

function AddPrModal({ onClose, onSave, presetExercise, defaultShare = true }) {
  const [exercise, setExercise] = useState(presetExercise || "");
  const [share, setShare] = useState(defaultShare);
  const [repMax, setRepMax] = useState("1RM");
  const [value, setValue] = useState("");
  const [date, setDate] = useState("");

  const valueError = SCORE_CONFIG.load.validate(value);
  const canSave = !valueError && Boolean(exercise);
  const finalName = repMax === "1RM" ? exercise : `${exercise} ${repMax}`;

  return (
    <div className="absolute inset-0 z-40 bg-black/80 flex items-end">
      <div className="w-full bg-neutral-950 border-t border-neutral-800 rounded-t-3xl p-5 pb-8 max-h-[92%] overflow-y-auto">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-5">
          <div className="text-lg font-display font-black text-neutral-50">
            Aggiungi PR
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="text-neutral-400">
            <X size={20} />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="text-[10px] tracking-widest text-neutral-500 mb-2">
          ESERCIZIO
        </div>
        {exercise ? (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-700 rounded-xl px-3.5 py-3 mb-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <Dumbbell size={15} className="text-neutral-400" />
              <span className="text-sm text-neutral-50 font-semibold">
                {exercise}
              </span>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setExercise("")}
              className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400"
            >
              Cambia
            </button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <SearchableLibrary
            library={EXERCISE_LIBRARY}
            onSelect={(item) => setExercise(item)}
            selectedName={exercise}
            placeholder="Cerca un esercizio…"
            onAddCustom={(q) => setExercise(q)}
            customLabel="Aggiungi"
          />
        )}

        <div className="text-[10px] tracking-widest text-neutral-500 mb-2">
          TIPO DI MASSIMALE
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-1.5 mb-4">
          {REP_MAXES.map((r) => (
            <button
              key={r}
              onClick={() => setRepMax(r)}
              className={`flex-1 text-[11px] rounded-lg py-2.5 font-bold ${
                repMax === r
                  ? "bg-neutral-100 text-black"
                  : "bg-neutral-900 text-neutral-400 border border-neutral-800"
              }`}
            >
              {r}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="text-[10px] tracking-widest text-neutral-500 mb-2">
          CARICO (KG)
        </div>
        <div
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 bg-neutral-900 border rounded-xl px-3 py-3 mb-1.5 ${
            valueError && value ? "border-neutral-500" : "border-neutral-800"
          }`}
        >
          <Dumbbell size={15} className="text-neutral-500 flex-shrink-0" />
          <input
            value={value}
            onChange={(e) => setValue(SCORE_CONFIG.load.format(e.target.value))}
            placeholder="Es. 150 oppure 122.5"
            inputMode="decimal"
            className="bg-transparent text-sm text-neutral-100 placeholder-neutral-600 outline-none w-full"
          />
          {value && !valueError && (
            <Check size={14} className="text-neutral-400 flex-shrink-0" />
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="text-[10px] mb-4 min-h-[14px]">
          {value && valueError ? (
            <span className="text-neutral-300">{valueError}</span>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-neutral-600">
              Chilogrammi, con mezzo chilo se serve
            </span>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="text-[10px] tracking-widest text-neutral-500 mb-2">
          DATA
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl px-3 py-3 mb-4">
          <Calendar size={15} className="text-neutral-500 flex-shrink-0" />
          <input
            value={date}
            onChange={(e) => setDate(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Es. 12 Set 2025"
            className="bg-transparent text-sm text-neutral-100 placeholder-neutral-600 outline-none w-full"
          />
        </div>

        <button
          onClick={() => setShare((v) => !v)}
          className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl px-3 py-3 mb-6"
        >
          <div
            className={`w-9 h-5 rounded-full flex-shrink-0 relative transition-colors ${
              share ? "bg-neutral-100" : "bg-neutral-700"
            }`}
          >
            <span
              className={`absolute top-0.5 w-4 h-4 rounded-full transition-all ${
                share ? "left-[18px] bg-black" : "left-0.5 bg-neutral-400"
              }`}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="text-left flex-1">
            <div className="text-[12px] text-neutral-200">
              {share ? "Visibile agli altri soci" : "PR privato"}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500">
              {share
                ? "Comparirà tra i record condivisi del box."
                : "Solo tu vedrai questo record."}
            </div>
          </div>
          {!share && <Lock size={13} className="text-neutral-500" />}
        </button>

        <button
          disabled={!canSave}
          onClick={() =>
            onSave({
              exercise: finalName,
              value: parseFloat(value),
              date: date || "Oggi",
              share,
            })
          }
          className={`w-full rounded-xl py-3.5 font-bold text-sm ${
            canSave
              ? "bg-neutral-100 text-black"
              : "bg-neutral-900 text-neutral-600 border border-neutral-800"
          }`}
        >
          SALVA PR
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function PrDetail({ exercise, history, onBack, onAdd, onDelete }) {
  const chartValues = [...history].reverse().map((h) => h.value);
  const current = history[0];
  const first = history[history.length - 1];
  const [menuFor, setMenuFor] = useState(null);

  return (
    <>
      <SubHeader
        title={exercise}
        backLabel="PROGRESS"
        subtitle={`${history.length} record registrati`}
        onBack={onBack}
      />

      <Card className="mb-4">
        <div className="text-xs tracking-[0.12em] text-neutral-300 font-semibold mb-4">
          ANDAMENTO
        </div>
        <LineChart values={chartValues} height={110} />
        <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-neutral-600 mt-1 mb-4">
          {[...history].reverse().map((h, i) => (
            <span key={i}>{h.date.split(" ")[1]}</span>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-neutral-800">
          <div>
            <div className="text-lg font-display font-black text-neutral-50">
              {current.value} kg
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500">PR attuale</div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="text-lg font-display font-black text-neutral-200">
              +{current.value - first.value} kg
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500">da inizio</div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="text-lg font-display font-black text-neutral-200">
              {history.length > 1
                ? `+${current.value - history[1].value} kg`
                : "—"}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500">vs precedente</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </Card>

      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <div className="text-xs tracking-[0.12em] text-neutral-400 font-semibold">
          STORICO
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={onAdd}
          className="text-[11px] font-semibold border border-neutral-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-neutral-200"
        >
          + Aggiungi
        </button>
      </div>
      <Card className="!p-0 overflow-hidden">
        {history.map((h, i) => (
          <div
            key={i}
            className={`relative flex items-center px-4 py-3.5 ${
              i !== history.length - 1 ? "border-b border-neutral-800" : ""
            }`}
          >
            <div className="flex-1 text-sm text-neutral-300">{h.date}</div>
            <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-50 mr-3">
              {h.value} kg
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setMenuFor(menuFor === i ? null : i)}
              className="text-neutral-500 px-1"
            >
              <MoreVertical size={16} />
            </button>
            {menuFor === i && (
              <div className="absolute right-3 top-11 z-20 bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-700 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-xl">
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    onDelete(i);
                    setMenuFor(null);
                  }}
                  className="block w-full text-left px-4 py-2.5 text-xs text-neutral-300 hover:bg-neutral-800"
                >
                  Elimina
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
      </Card>
    </>
  );
}

function ProgressPr({ records, setRecords, histories, setHistories, defaultShare }) {
  const [selectedPr, setSelectedPr] = useState("Back Squat");
  const [detailFor, setDetailFor] = useState(null);
  const [showAdd, setShowAdd] = useState(false);
  const [showAllPr, setShowAllPr] = useState(false);
  const [pickerOpen, setPickerOpen] = useState(false);

  function historyFor(name) {
    return histories[name] || [];
  }

  function handleSave({ exercise, value, date, share }) {
    setHistories((prev) => {
      const list = prev[exercise] ? [...prev[exercise]] : [];
      return { ...prev, [exercise]: [{ date, value }, ...list] };
    });
    setRecords((prev) => {
      const existing = prev.find((p) => p.name === exercise);
      if (existing) {
        const delta =
          value > existing.value ? `+${value - existing.value} kg` : existing.delta;
        const updated = {
          ...existing,
          value: Math.max(existing.value, value),
          date,
          delta,
          share,
        };
        return [updated, ...prev.filter((p) => p.name !== exercise)];
      }
      return [
        { name: exercise, value, unit: "kg", date, delta: null, share },
        ...prev,
      ];
    });
    setSelectedPr(exercise);
    setShowAdd(false);
  }

  function handleDelete(index) {
    setHistories((prev) => {
      const list = [...(prev[detailFor] || [])];
      list.splice(index, 1);
      return { ...prev, [detailFor]: list };
    });
  }

  const prRow = (pr, i, total) => (
    <button
      key={pr.name}
      onClick={() => setDetailFor(pr.name)}
      className={`w-full flex items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3 text-left ${
        i !== total - 1 ? "border-b border-neutral-800" : ""
      }`}
    >
      <Dumbbell size={15} className="text-neutral-400 flex-shrink-0" />
      <div className="flex-1 text-sm text-neutral-100 min-w-0 truncate flex items-center gap-1.5">
        <span className="truncate">{pr.name}</span>
        {pr.share === false && (
          <Lock size={11} className="text-neutral-600 flex-shrink-0" />
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-50 flex-shrink-0">
        {pr.value} {pr.unit}
      </div>
      <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-600 flex-shrink-0 w-16 text-right">
        {pr.date}
      </div>
      <div className="w-12 text-right flex-shrink-0">
        {pr.delta ? (
          <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-200 rounded px-1.5 py-1">
            {pr.delta}
          </span>
        ) : (
          <span className="text-neutral-700">—</span>
        )}
      </div>
      <ChevronRight size={13} className="text-neutral-600 flex-shrink-0" />
    </button>
  );

  if (showAllPr) {
    return (
      <>
        <SubHeader
          title="Tutti i personal record"
          backLabel="PROGRESS"
          subtitle={`${records.length} esercizi registrati`}
          onBack={() => setShowAllPr(false)}
        />
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowAdd(true)}
          className="w-full mb-4 border border-neutral-700 border-dashed rounded-2xl py-3.5 text-xs font-semibold text-neutral-200"
        >
          + AGGIUNGI PR
        </button>
        <Card className="!p-0 overflow-hidden">
          {records.map((pr, i) => prRow(pr, i, records.length))}
        </Card>
        {showAdd && (
          <AddPrModal
            defaultShare={defaultShare}
            onClose={() => setShowAdd(false)}
            onSave={handleSave}
          />
        )}
      </>
    );
  }

  if (detailFor) {
    const history = historyFor(detailFor);
    return (
      <>
        {history.length > 0 ? (
          <PrDetail
            exercise={detailFor}
            history={history}
            onBack={() => setDetailFor(null)}
            onAdd={() => setShowAdd(true)}
            onDelete={handleDelete}
          />
        ) : (
          <>
            <SubHeader
              title={detailFor}
              backLabel="PROGRESS"
              subtitle="Nessun record registrato"
              onBack={() => setDetailFor(null)}
            />
            <Card className="flex flex-col items-center text-center py-10">
              <Dumbbell size={24} className="text-neutral-600 mb-3" />
              <div className="text-sm text-neutral-400 mb-4">
                Non hai ancora registrato un PR per questo esercizio.
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowAdd(true)}
                className="bg-neutral-100 text-black rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold"
              >
                + AGGIUNGI PR
              </button>
            </Card>
          </>
        )}
        {showAdd && (
          <AddPrModal
            presetExercise={detailFor}
            defaultShare={defaultShare}
            onClose={() => setShowAdd(false)}
            onSave={handleSave}
          />
        )}
      </>
    );
  }

  const recentRecords = records.slice(0, 5);
  const history = historyFor(selectedPr);
  const chartValues = [...history].reverse().map((h) => h.value);
  const current = history[0];
  const first = history[history.length - 1];

  return (
    <>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <div className="text-xs tracking-[0.12em] text-neutral-400 font-semibold">
          ULTIMI PERSONAL RECORD
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowAdd(true)}
          className="text-[11px] font-semibold border border-neutral-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-neutral-200"
        >
          + Aggiungi PR
        </button>
      </div>
      <Card className="mb-2 !p-0 overflow-hidden">
        {recentRecords.map((pr, i) => prRow(pr, i, recentRecords.length))}
      </Card>
      {records.length > 5 && (
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowAllPr(true)}
          className="w-full mb-5 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 py-2.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-neutral-400"
        >
          VEDI TUTTI I {records.length} PR <ChevronRight size={12} />
        </button>
      )}
      {records.length <= 5 && <div className="mb-5" />}

      <Card className="mb-5">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <div className="text-xs tracking-[0.12em] text-neutral-300 font-semibold">
            ANDAMENTO PR
          </div>
          <div className="relative">
            <button
              onClick={() => setPickerOpen((v) => !v)}
              className="text-[11px] text-neutral-200 border border-neutral-700 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 flex items-center gap-1.5"
            >
              {selectedPr}
              <ChevronDown size={12} className="text-neutral-500" />
            </button>
            {pickerOpen && (
              <div className="absolute right-0 top-9 z-20 bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-700 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-xl w-40 max-h-56 overflow-y-auto">
                {records.map((pr) => (
                  <button
                    key={pr.name}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setSelectedPr(pr.name);
                      setPickerOpen(false);
                    }}
                    className={`block w-full text-left px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[11px] ${
                      selectedPr === pr.name
                        ? "bg-neutral-800 text-neutral-50"
                        : "text-neutral-300"
                    }`}
                  >
                    {pr.name}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
        {history.length > 0 ? (
          <>
            <LineChart values={chartValues} height={100} />
            <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-neutral-600 mt-1 mb-4">
              {[...history].reverse().map((h, i) => (
                <span key={i}>{h.date.split(" ")[1]}</span>
              ))}
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-neutral-800">
              <div>
                <div className="text-lg font-display font-black text-neutral-50">
                  {current.value} kg
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500">PR attuale</div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-lg font-display font-black text-neutral-200">
                  +{current.value - first.value} kg
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500">
                  da inizio percorso
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-lg font-display font-black text-neutral-200">
                  {history.length > 1
                    ? `+${current.value - history[1].value} kg`
                    : "—"}
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-500">
                  rispetto al precedente
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </>
        ) : (
          <div className="text-sm text-neutral-500 py-6 text-center">
            Nessuno storico per {selectedPr}.
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      <div className="text-xs tracking-[0.12em] text-neutral-400 font-semibold mb-3">
        STORICO
      </div>
      <Card className="!p-0 overflow-hidden">
        {history.length > 0 ? (
          history.map((h, i) => (
            <div
              key={i}
              className={`flex items-center px-4 py-3 ${
                i !== history.length - 1 ? "border-b border-neutral-800" : ""
              }`}
            >
              <div className="flex-1 text-sm text-neutral-300">{h.date}</div>
              <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-50">
                {h.value} kg
              </div>
            </div>
          ))
        ) : (
          <div className="text-sm text-neutral-500 px-4 py-5 text-center">
            Nessun record.
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      {showAdd && (
        <AddPrModal
          presetExercise={selectedPr}
          defaultShare={defaultShare}
          onClose={() => setShowAdd(false)}
          onSave={handleSave}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}

function ProgressScreen({
  benchmarks,
  setBenchmarks,
  prRecords,
  setPrRecords,
  prHistories,
  setPrHistories,
  privacy,
}) {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("Panoramica");
  const [subview, setSubview] = useState(null);
  const [showAddBenchmark, setShowAddBenchmark] = useState(false);
  const tabs = ["Panoramica", "WOD", "PR"];

  if (subview) {
    const back = () => setSubview(null);
    return (
      <div className="px-5 pb-28 pt-1">
        {subview === "activities" && <ActivitiesDetail onBack={back} />}
        {subview === "weeks" && <WeeksDetail onBack={back} />}
        {subview === "stats" && <GeneralStatsDetail onBack={back} />}
        {subview === "scores" && <AllScoresDetail onBack={back} />}
        {subview === "benchmark" && (
          <BenchmarkDetail
            benchmarks={benchmarks}
            onAdd={() => setShowAddBenchmark(true)}
            onDelete={(i) =>
              setBenchmarks((prev) => prev.filter((_, idx) => idx !== i))
            }
            onBack={back}
          />
        )}
        {showAddBenchmark && (
          <AddBenchmarkModal
            onClose={() => setShowAddBenchmark(false)}
            onSave={(b) => {
              setBenchmarks((prev) => [b, ...prev]);
              setShowAddBenchmark(false);
            }}
          />
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="px-5 pb-28 pt-1">
      <div className="text-3xl font-display font-black text-neutral-50 mb-4">
        PROGRESS
      </div>

      <div className="flex gap-1 bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl p-1 mb-5">
        {tabs.map((t) => (
          <button
            key={t}
            onClick={() => setTab(t)}
            className={`flex-1 rounded-lg py-2.5 text-xs font-semibold ${
              tab === t ? "bg-neutral-100 text-black" : "text-neutral-400"
            }`}
          >
            {t}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {tab === "Panoramica" && <ProgressOverview onOpen={setSubview} />}
      {tab === "WOD" && (
        <ProgressWod onOpen={setSubview} benchmarks={benchmarks} />
      )}
      {tab === "PR" && (
        <ProgressPr
          records={prRecords}
          setRecords={setPrRecords}
          histories={prHistories}
          setHistories={setPrHistories}
          defaultShare={privacy.sharePr}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// Un socio può prenotare solo se abbonamento e certificato sono validi
// NEL GIORNO della classe, non solo oggi.
// targetDate: oggetto giorno del calendario (opzionale). Se assente, controlla oggi.
/** scope "classi" (default) o "openbox": un pacchetto solo Open Box
    blocca le classi ma non gli accessi liberi. */
function getBookingBlocks(targetDate, scope = "classi") {
  const blocks = [];

  if (scope === "classi" && MEMBER.plan.includesClasses === false) {
    blocks.push({
      key: "access",
      title: "Il tuo abbonamento non include le classi",
      message:
        "Hai un pacchetto Open Box: puoi prenotare gli accessi liberi. Per le classi passa in reception e cambia abbonamento.",
    });
  }

  const when = targetDate ? new Date(targetDate) : new Date();
  when.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

  const planEnd = parseItalianDate(MEMBER.plan.expiry);
  const certEnd = parseItalianDate(MEMBER.medicalCertificate.expiry);
  const isFuture = targetDate && when.getTime() > new Date().setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

  if (planEnd && when.getTime() > planEnd.getTime()) {
    blocks.push({
      key: "plan",
      title: isFuture
        ? "Abbonamento scaduto a quella data"
        : "Abbonamento scaduto",
      message: isFuture
        ? `Il tuo abbonamento scade il ${MEMBER.plan.expiry}: rinnova in reception per prenotare anche dopo quella data.`
        : "Rinnova in reception per tornare a prenotare classi e Open Box.",
    });
  }

  if (certEnd && when.getTime() > certEnd.getTime()) {
    blocks.push({
      key: "cert",
      title: isFuture
        ? "Certificato medico scaduto a quella data"
        : "Certificato medico scaduto",
      message: isFuture
        ? `Il tuo certificato scade il ${MEMBER.medicalCertificate.expiry}: portane uno nuovo in reception per prenotare anche dopo quella data.`
        : "Porta il nuovo certificato in reception: senza non è possibile prenotare.",
    });
  }

  return blocks;
}
