function PersonalDataScreen({ onBack, phone, onChangePhone, email, onChangeEmail, photo, onChangePhoto, onContact }) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null); // "Telefono" | "Email" | null
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState("");
  const fileRef = React.useRef(null);

  function handleFile(e) {
    const file = e.target.files && e.target.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => onChangePhoto(reader.result);
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  }

  const rows = [
    { label: "Nome", value: MEMBER.firstName, locked: true },
    { label: "Cognome", value: MEMBER.lastName, locked: true },
    { label: "Telefono", value: phone, locked: false },
    { label: "Email", value: email, locked: false },
    { label: "Data di nascita", value: MEMBER.birthDate, locked: true },
  ];

  return (
    <>
      <SubHeader title="Dati personali" onBack={onBack} backLabel="PROFILO" topPad />

      <input
        ref={fileRef}
        type="file"
        accept="image/*"
        onChange={handleFile}
        style={{ display: "none" }}
      />
      <button
        onClick={() => fileRef.current && fileRef.current.click()}
        className="w-full text-left mb-4"
      >
        <Card className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-neutral-800 border border-neutral-700 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 overflow-hidden">
            {photo ? (
              <img
                src={photo}
                alt="Foto profilo"

              />

              <User size={26} className="text-neutral-400" />
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1">
            <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-50">
              Foto profilo
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs text-neutral-500">
              {photo ? "Tocca per cambiarla" : "Cambia la tua foto"}
            </div>
          </div>
          <ChevronRight size={16} className="text-neutral-600" />
        </Card>
      </button>
      {photo && (
        <button
          onClick={() => onChangePhoto(null)}
          className="w-full mb-4 text-[11px] text-neutral-500 py-1"
        >
          Rimuovi foto
        </button>
      )}

      <Card className="mb-4 !p-0 overflow-hidden">
        {rows.map((r, i) => (
          <div
            key={r.label}
            className={`px-4 py-3.5 ${
              i !== rows.length - 1 ? "border-b border-neutral-800" : ""
            }`}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="text-sm text-neutral-400 w-28 flex-shrink-0">
                {r.label}
              </div>
              {editing === r.label ? (
                <input
                  value={draft}
                  onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
                  className="flex-1 bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm text-neutral-50 outline-none"
                />
              ) : (
                <div className="flex-1 text-sm text-neutral-50">{r.value}</div>
              )}
              {!r.locked &&
                (editing === r.label ? (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      if (r.label === "Telefono") onChangePhone(draft);
                      else onChangeEmail(draft);
                      setEditing(null);
                    }}
                    className="text-[11px] font-semibold bg-neutral-100 text-black rounded-lg px-3 py-2 flex-shrink-0"
                  >
                    Salva
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  <button
                    onClick={() => {
                      setDraft(r.value);
                      setEditing(r.label);
                    }}
                    className="text-[11px] font-semibold border border-neutral-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-neutral-200 flex-shrink-0"
                  >
                    Modifica
                  </button>
                ))}
            </div>
            {r.locked && (
              <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-600 text-right mt-1">
                Non modificabile
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ))}
      </Card>

      <Card>
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3 mb-4">
          <div className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full border border-neutral-600 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5 text-[10px] text-neutral-400">
            i
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs text-neutral-400 leading-relaxed">
            Nome, cognome e data di nascita li può correggere solo lo staff, in
            reception e con un documento: servono a garantire che dietro ogni
            account ci sia sempre la stessa persona. Il cambio di email viene
            segnalato allo staff.
          </div>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={onContact}
          className="w-full border border-neutral-700 rounded-xl py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-100"
        >
          Contatta PEAK
        </button>
      </Card>
    </>
  );
}

function ChangePasswordScreen({ onBack }) {
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState("");
  const [next, setNext] = useState("");
  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState("");
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  const [done, setDone] = useState(false);

  const canSave = current && next && next === confirm && next.length >= 8;

  return (
    <>
      <SubHeader title="Cambia password" onBack={onBack} backLabel="PROFILO" topPad />

      {done ? (
        <Card className="flex flex-col items-center text-center py-10">
          <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full border border-neutral-700 flex items-center justify-center mb-4">
            <Check size={22} className="text-neutral-200" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-50 mb-1">
            Password aggiornata
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs text-neutral-500">
            Usa la nuova password al prossimo accesso.
          </div>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 mb-4">
            <AuthInput
              icon={Lock}
              value={current}
              onChange={(e) => setCurrent(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Password attuale"
              showToggle
              visible={show}
              onToggleVisible={() => setShow((v) => !v)}
            />
            <AuthInput
              icon={Lock}
              value={next}
              onChange={(e) => setNext(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Nuova password"
              showToggle
              visible={show}
              onToggleVisible={() => setShow((v) => !v)}
            />
            <AuthInput
              icon={Lock}
              value={confirm}
              onChange={(e) => setConfirm(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Conferma nuova password"
              showToggle
              visible={show}
              onToggleVisible={() => setShow((v) => !v)}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-500 mb-5 leading-relaxed">
            La password deve contenere almeno 8 caratteri.
            {next && confirm && next !== confirm && (
              <span className="block text-neutral-300 mt-1">
                Le due password non coincidono.
              </span>
            )}
          </div>

          <button
            disabled={!canSave}
            onClick={() => setDone(true)}
            className={`w-full rounded-xl py-3.5 font-bold text-sm ${
              canSave
                ? "bg-neutral-100 text-black"
                : "bg-neutral-900 text-neutral-600 border border-neutral-800"
            }`}
          >
            AGGIORNA PASSWORD
          </button>
        </>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

function ProfileScreen({
  onLogout,
  privacy,
  onTogglePrivacy,
  phone,
  setPhone,
  email,
  setEmail,
  photo,
  setPhoto,
  notifSettings,
  onToggleNotif,
  onSubviewChange,
}) {
  const [subview, setSubviewState] = useState(null);
  const [confirmLogout, setConfirmLogout] = useState(false);

  // La shell deve sapere quando siamo dentro una sottoschermata,
  // altrimenti continua a disegnare la TopBar sopra il SubHeader.
  const setSubview = (value) => {
    setSubviewState(value);
    if (onSubviewChange) onSubviewChange(value);
  };

  const back = () => setSubview(null);

  if (subview) {
    return (
      <div className="px-5 pb-28 pt-1">
        {subview === "personal" && (
          <PersonalDataScreen
            onBack={back}
            phone={phone}
            onChangePhone={setPhone}
            email={email}
            onChangeEmail={setEmail}
            photo={photo}
            onChangePhoto={setPhoto}
            onContact={() => setSubview("support")}
          />
        )}
        {subview === "notifications" && (
          <NotificationSettingsScreen
            onBack={back}
            settings={notifSettings}
            onToggle={onToggleNotif}
          />
        )}
        {subview === "privacy" && (
          <PrivacyScreen
            onBack={back}
            privacy={privacy}
            onToggle={onTogglePrivacy}
          />
        )}
        {subview === "policy" && <PrivacyPolicyScreen onBack={back} />}
        {subview === "password" && <ChangePasswordScreen onBack={back} />}
        {subview === "install" && <InstallScreen onBack={back} />}
        {subview === "support" && <SupportScreen onBack={back} />}
        {subview === "card" && <MembershipCardScreen onBack={back} />}
        {subview === "membership" && <MembershipScreen onBack={back} />}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="px-5 pb-28 pt-1">
      <button
        onClick={() => setSubview("personal")}
        className="w-full flex items-center gap-4 mb-5 text-left"
      >
        <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-full bg-neutral-800 border border-neutral-700 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 overflow-hidden">
          {photo ? (
            <img
              src={photo}
              alt="Foto profilo"
              className="w-full h-full object-cover"
            />
          ) : (
            <User size={32} className="text-neutral-400" />
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1">
          <div className="text-2xl font-display font-black text-neutral-50">
            {MEMBER.firstName} {MEMBER.lastName}
          </div>
          <div className="text-sm text-neutral-500">
            Member since {MEMBER.memberSince}
          </div>
        </div>
        <ChevronRight size={20} className="text-neutral-600" />
      </button>

      <button
        onClick={() => setSubview("membership")}
        className="w-full text-left mb-3"
      >
        <Card>
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
            <div className="text-sm font-bold text-neutral-50 tracking-wide">
              IL TUO ABBONAMENTO
            </div>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold rounded-full px-3 py-1.5 bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-900">
              {MEMBER.plan.status}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="text-2xl font-display font-black text-neutral-50 mb-1">
            {MEMBER.plan.name}
          </div>
          <div className="text-xs text-neutral-400 leading-relaxed mb-3">
            {MEMBER.plan.description}
          </div>
          <div className="h-px bg-neutral-800 mb-3" />
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2.5">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-neutral-400">
              <Calendar size={15} /> Scadenza
            </span>
            <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-neutral-50">
              {MEMBER.plan.expiry}
            </span>

}

/** Data di nascita a tre tendine, come nella console admin: stesso formato
    per tutti, sia che la inserisca il socio sia che la corregga lo staff. */
function BirthDateSelect({ value, onChange }) {
  const parts = (value || "").split("-");
  const [sel, setSel] = useState({
    y: parts[0] || "",
    m: parts[1] ? String(Number(parts[1])) : "",
    d: parts[2] ? String(Number(parts[2])) : "",
  });

  const mesi = ["gen","feb","mar","apr","mag","giu","lug","ago","set","ott","nov","dic"];
  const thisYear = new Date().getFullYear();
  const years = [];
  for (let y = thisYear - 12; y >= thisYear - 90; y--) years.push(y);
  const daysInMonth =
    sel.m && sel.y ? new Date(Number(sel.y), Number(sel.m), 0).getDate() : 31;

  function update(next) {
    if (next.m && next.y && next.d) {
      const max = new Date(Number(next.y), Number(next.m), 0).getDate();
      if (Number(next.d) > max) next = { ...next, d: String(max) };
    }
    setSel(next);
    onChange(
      next.d && next.m && next.y
        ? `${next.y}-${String(next.m).padStart(2, "0")}-${String(next.d).padStart(2, "0")}`
        : ""
    );
  }

  const box =
    "bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl px-3 py-3.5 text-sm text-neutral-50 outline-none appearance-none";

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-500 mb-2 ml-1">Data di nascita</div>
      <div className="grid grid-cols-[1fr_1.3fr_1.2fr] gap-2">
        <select value={sel.d} onChange={(e) => update({ ...sel, d: e.target.value })} className={box}>
          <option value="">Giorno</option>
          {Array.from({ length: daysInMonth }, (_, i) => i + 1).map((d) => (
            <option key={d} value={d}>{d}</option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <select value={sel.m} onChange={(e) => update({ ...sel, m: e.target.value })} className={box}>
          <option value="">Mese</option>
          {mesi.map((name, i) => (
            <option key={name} value={i + 1}>{name}</option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <select value={sel.y} onChange={(e) => update({ ...sel, y: e.target.value })} className={box}>
          <option value="">Anno</option>
          {years.map((y) => (
            <option key={y} value={y}>{y}</option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function RegisterScreen({ onBack, onSubmit }) {
  const [nome, setNome] = useState("");
  const [cognome, setCognome] = useState("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPw, setConfirmPw] = useState("");
  const [showPw, setShowPw] = useState(false);
  const [showConfirmPw, setShowConfirmPw] = useState(false);
  const [telefono, setTelefono] = useState("");
  const [nascita, setNascita] = useState("");
  const [accepted, setAccepted] = useState(false);
  // Il consenso a foto e video è separato e facoltativo: accorparlo
  // all'informativa lo renderebbe non valido, perché deve poter essere
  // negato o revocato senza impedire l'iscrizione.
  const [mediaConsent, setMediaConsent] = useState(false);
  const [showPolicy, setShowPolicy] = useState(false);

  // Telefono e data di nascita servono allo staff: il primo per contattare
  // chi salta una classe, la seconda per il tesseramento. Meglio chiederli
  // qui che rincorrere la persona dopo.
  const canSubmit =
    nome && cognome && email && telefono && nascita &&
    password && password === confirmPw && accepted;

  if (showPolicy) {
    return (
      <div className="h-full flex flex-col px-6 pb-4 pt-14 overflow-y-auto">
        <PrivacyPolicyScreen onBack={() => setShowPolicy(false)} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="h-full flex flex-col px-6 pb-4 pt-14 overflow-y-auto">
      <button onClick={onBack} className="absolute top-14 left-6 text-neutral-300">
        <ChevronLeft size={22} />
      </button>
      <div className="text-center font-display font-bold text-lg text-neutral-50 mb-1">
        Crea account
      </div>
      <div className="text-center text-xs text-neutral-400 mb-6 px-4 leading-relaxed">
        Compila i tuoi dati per richiedere l'accesso a PEAK.
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col items-center mb-6">
        <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-neutral-900 border border-neutral-700 flex items-center justify-center mb-2">
          <Camera size={20} className="text-neutral-400" />
        </div>
        <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400">Aggiungi foto</div>
        <div className="text-[10px] text-neutral-600">(profilo facoltativa)</div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 mb-4">
        <AuthInput icon={User} value={nome} onChange={(e) => setNome(e.target.value)} placeholder="Nome" />
        <AuthInput icon={User} value={cognome} onChange={(e) => setCognome(e.target.value)} placeholder="Cognome" />
        <AuthInput icon={Mail} value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} placeholder="Email" />
        <AuthInput
          icon={Phone}
          value={telefono}
          onChange={(e) => setTelefono(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Telefono"
        />
        <BirthDateSelect value={nascita} onChange={setNascita} />
        <AuthInput
          icon={Lock}
          value={password}
          onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Password"
          showToggle
          visible={showPw}
          onToggleVisible={() => setShowPw((v) => !v)}
        />
        <AuthInput
          icon={Lock}
          value={confirmPw}
          onChange={(e) => setConfirmPw(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Conferma password"
          showToggle
          visible={showConfirmPw}
          onToggleVisible={() => setShowConfirmPw((v) => !v)}
        />
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 mb-5">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <button
            onClick={() => setAccepted((v) => !v)}
            className={`w-4 h-4 rounded border flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5 flex items-center justify-center ${
              accepted ? "bg-neutral-50 border-neutral-50" : "border-neutral-600"
            }`}
            aria-label="Accetto l'informativa privacy"
          >
            {accepted && <Check size={11} className="text-black" strokeWidth={3} />}
          </button>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 leading-relaxed">
            Dichiaro di aver letto e accettato l'
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowPolicy(true)}
              className="text-neutral-100 underline"
            >
              informativa privacy
            </button>
            <span className="text-neutral-500"> · obbligatorio</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
          <button
            onClick={() => setMediaConsent((v) => !v)}
            className={`w-4 h-4 rounded border flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5 flex items-center justify-center ${
              mediaConsent ? "bg-neutral-50 border-neutral-50" : "border-neutral-600"
            }`}
            aria-label="Consenso a foto e video"
          >
            {mediaConsent && <Check size={11} className="text-black" strokeWidth={3} />}
          </button>
          <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 leading-relaxed">
            Acconsento alla pubblicazione di foto e video che mi ritraggono sui
            canali PEAK
            <span className="text-neutral-500">
              {" "}
              · facoltativo, revocabile in ogni momento
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <button
        disabled={!canSubmit}
        onClick={onSubmit}
        className={`w-full rounded-xl py-3.5 font-bold text-sm tracking-wide mb-4 ${
          canSubmit
            ? "bg-neutral-50 text-black"
            : "bg-neutral-900 text-neutral-600 border border-neutral-800"
        }`}
      >
        INVIA RICHIESTA
      </button>

      <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5 bg-neutral-900/60 border border-neutral-800 rounded-xl p-3.5">
        <div className="w-4 h-4 rounded-full border border-neutral-600 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5 text-[9px] text-neutral-400">
          i
        </div>
        <div className="text-[11px] text-neutral-400 leading-relaxed">
          Dopo la registrazione il tuo profilo verrà verificato dal nostro
          staff. Riceverai una notifica quando sarà attivo.
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

        </Card>
      )}

      {unread.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
            <div className="text-xs tracking-[0.12em] text-neutral-400 font-semibold">
              DA LEGGERE
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold bg-neutral-100 text-black rounded-full px-2 py-0.5">
              {unread.length}
            </span>
          </div>
          <Card className="!p-0 overflow-hidden mb-6">
            {unread.map((n) => (
              <NotificationItem key={n.id} n={n} onOpen={onOpen} />
            ))}
          </Card>
        </>
      )}

      {read.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <div className="text-xs tracking-[0.12em] text-neutral-500 font-semibold mb-3">
            GIÀ LETTE
          </div>
          <Card className="!p-0 overflow-hidden">
            {read.map((n) => (
              <NotificationItem key={n.id} n={n} onOpen={onOpen} />
            ))}
          </Card>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


function AnnouncementDetailScreen({ announcement, onBack }) {
  if (!announcement) return null;
  return (
    <div className="px-5 pb-28 pt-1">
      <div className="w-full h-40 rounded-2xl bg-neutral-950 border border-neutral-800 flex items-center justify-center mb-5">
        <div className="text-neutral-50 text-xl font-display font-black text-center uppercase leading-tight px-4">
          {announcement.title}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="text-2xl font-display font-black text-neutral-50 mb-1">
        {announcement.title}
      </div>
      <div className="text-neutral-500 text-xs mb-5">
        {announcement.subtitle}
      </div>

      <Card>
        <div className="text-neutral-300 text-sm leading-relaxed">
          {announcement.body}
        </div>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function PeakApp() {
  const [authStage, setAuthStage] = useState("login"); // login | forgot | register | pending | app
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("home");
  const [selectedDay, setSelectedDay] = useState(DAYS[0].date);
  const [bookedIds, setBookedIds] = useState([]);
  const [waitlistIds, setWaitlistIds] = useState([]);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState(null);
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState(NOTIFICATIONS_MOCK);
  const [extraBookings, setExtraBookings] = useState({});
  const [openClass, setOpenClass] = useState(null);
  const [overlay, setOverlay] = useState(null); // "notifications" | "announcement" | "openbox"
  const [openBoxByDay, setOpenBoxByDay] = useState({});
  const [openAnnouncement, setOpenAnnouncement] = useState(null);
  const [myScores, setMyScores] = useState({});
  const [privacy, setPrivacy] = useState({
    mediaConsent: false, // facoltativo: si attiva solo se il socio lo sceglie
    shareScores: true,
    sharePr: true,
  });
  const [prRecords, setPrRecords] = useState(PERSONAL_RECORDS);
  const [prHistories, setPrHistories] = useState(PR_HISTORY);
  const [benchmarks, setBenchmarks] = useState(ALL_BENCHMARKS);
  const [phone, setPhone] = useState(MEMBER.phone);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState(MEMBER.email);
  const [photo, setPhoto] = useState(null);
  const [profileSub, setProfileSub] = useState(null);
  const [notifSettings, setNotifSettings] = useState({
    conferma: true,
    promemoria: true,
    cancellazioni: true,
    attesa: true,
    scadenzaAbb: true,
    scadenzaTessera: true,
    scadenzaCert: true,
    news: true,
    eventi: true,
  });

  const selectedDayObj = DAYS.find((d) => d.date === selectedDay);
  const classes = buildClassesForDay(selectedDayObj).map((c) => ({
    ...c,
    booked: c.booked + (extraBookings[c.id] || 0),
  }));

  // Prima classe prenotata di oggi, mostrata nella Home
  const todayClasses = buildClassesForDay(DAYS[0]).map((c) => ({
    ...c,
    booked: c.booked + (extraBookings[c.id] || 0),
  }));
  const bookedTodayId = todayClasses.find((c) => bookedIds.includes(c.id))?.id;

  // tutte le prenotazioni attive (classi + open box), ordinate per data
  const allBookings = [];
  DAYS.forEach((d) => {
    buildClassesForDay(d).forEach((cl) => {
      const booked = bookedIds.includes(cl.id);
      const waiting = waitlistIds.includes(cl.id);
      if (!booked && !waiting) return;
      const start = classStartDate(d, cl.time);
      if (start && start.getTime() < Date.now()) return;
      allBookings.push({
        key: cl.id,
        kind: "class",
        label: cl.type,
        dayLabel: d.isToday ? "Oggi" : `${d.label} ${d.date}`,
        time: cl.time,
        waiting,
        day: d.date,
        classItem: cl,
        start,
      });
    });
    (openBoxByDay[d.date] || []).forEach((slot) => {
      const start = classStartDate(d, slot);
      if (start && start.getTime() < Date.now()) return;
      allBookings.push({
        key: `ob-${d.key}-${slot}`,
        kind: "openbox",
        label: "Open Box",
        dayLabel: d.isToday ? "Oggi" : `${d.label} ${d.date}`,
        time: `${slot} – ${addMinutesToTime(slot, 60)}`,
        waiting: false,
        day: d.date,
        start,
      });
    });
  });
  allBookings.sort((a, b) => (a.start || 0) - (b.start || 0));

  function openNotification(n) {
    setNotifications((prev) =>
      prev.map((x) => (x.id === n.id ? { ...x, read: true } : x))
    );
    const t = n.target;
    if (!t) {
      setOverlay(null);
      return;
    }
    if (t.type === "class") {
      // apre la prima classe utile del giorno indicato
      const dayObj =
        t.when === "today"
          ? DAYS.find((d) => !isClosedDay(d))
          : DAYS.filter((d) => !isClosedDay(d))[1] || DAYS[0];
      const list = buildClassesForDay(dayObj);
      if (list.length > 0) {
        setSelectedDay(dayObj.date);
        setOverlay(null);
        setOpenClass(list[0]);
        return;
      }
      setOverlay(null);
      setTab("classes");
      return;
    }
    if (t.type === "wod") {
      setOverlay(null);
      const firstOpen = DAYS.find((d) => WOD_WEEK[d.date]);
      if (firstOpen) setSelectedDay(firstOpen.date);
      setTab("wod");
      return;
    }
    if (t.type === "membership") {
      setOverlay(null);
      setTab("profile");
      return;
    }
    if (t.type === "announcement") {
      setOpenAnnouncement(ANNOUNCEMENTS[0]);
      setOverlay("announcement");
      return;
    }
    setOverlay(null);
  }

  function showToast(message) {
    setToast(message);
    setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 4000);
  }

  function toggleBook(id) {
    const willBook = !bookedIds.includes(id);
    setExtraBookings((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [id]: (prev[id] || 0) + (willBook ? 1 : -1),
    }));
    setBookedIds((prev) =>
      willBook ? [...prev, id] : prev.filter((x) => x !== id)
    );
    if (willBook) {
      showToast("Prenotazione confermata");
    } else {
      showToast("Prenotazione annullata. Il posto è stato liberato.");
    }
  }

  function toggleWaitlist(id) {
    const willJoin = !waitlistIds.includes(id);
    setWaitlistIds((prev) =>
      willJoin ? [...prev, id] : prev.filter((x) => x !== id)
    );
    showToast(
      willJoin
        ? "Sei in lista d'attesa. Ti avvisiamo se si libera un posto."
        : "Sei uscito dalla lista d'attesa."
    );
  }

  // promozione automatica: se sei in lista e si libera un posto, entri in classe
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (waitlistIds.length === 0) return;
    const allDays = DAYS.map((d) => buildClassesForDay(d)).flat();
    waitlistIds.forEach((id) => {
      const cls = allDays.find((x) => x.id === id);
      if (!cls) return;
      const current = cls.booked + (extraBookings[id] || 0);
      if (current < cls.capacity) {
        setWaitlistIds((prev) => prev.filter((x) => x !== id));
        setBookedIds((prev) => (prev.includes(id) ? prev : [...prev, id]));
        setExtraBookings((prev) => ({ ...prev, [id]: (prev[id] || 0) + 1 }));
        showToast(
          `Sei entrato dalla lista d'attesa: ${cls.time} ${cls.type}. Prenotazione confermata!`
        );
      }
    });
  }, [waitlistIds, extraBookings]);

  if (authStage !== "app") {
    let authScreen;
    if (authStage === "login") {
      authScreen = (
        <LoginScreen
          onLogin={() => setAuthStage("app")}
          onCreateAccount={() => setAuthStage("register")}
          onForgotPassword={() => setAuthStage("forgot")}
        />
      );
    } else if (authStage === "forgot") {
      authScreen = <ForgotPasswordScreen onBack={() => setAuthStage("login")} />;
    } else if (authStage === "register") {
      authScreen = (
        <RegisterScreen
          onBack={() => setAuthStage("login")}
          onSubmit={() => setAuthStage("pending")}
        />
      );
    } else if (authStage === "pending") {
      authScreen = <PendingApprovalScreen onExit={() => setAuthStage("login")} />;
    }

    return (
      <div
        className="w-full min-h-screen bg-black flex items-center justify-center py-6"
        style={{ fontFamily: "'Montserrat', sans-serif" }}
      >
        <style>{`
          @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow:wght@700;800;900&family=Montserrat:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');
          .font-display { font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; }
        `}</style>
        <div className="relative w-[380px] h-[780px] bg-black rounded-[2.5rem] border-4 border-neutral-800 overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
          <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 h-6 flex items-center justify-between px-7 text-[11px] text-neutral-50 z-20">
            <span>9:41</span>
            <span>●●●●</span>
          </div>
          <div className="h-full overflow-y-auto pt-6">{authScreen}</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  let screen;
  if (overlay === "notifications") {
    screen = (
      <NotificationsScreen
        notifications={notifications}
        onOpen={openNotification}
        onReadAll={() =>
          setNotifications((prev) => prev.map((n) => ({ ...n, read: true })))
        }
      />
    );
  } else if (overlay === "announcement") {
    screen = (
      <AnnouncementDetailScreen
        announcement={openAnnouncement}
        onBack={() => setOverlay(null)}
      />
    );
  } else if (overlay === "openbox") {
    screen = (
      <OpenBoxScreen
        selectedDay={selectedDay}
        bookedSlots={openBoxByDay[selectedDay] || []}
        onConfirm={(slots) => {
          setOpenBoxByDay((prev) => ({ ...prev, [selectedDay]: slots }));
          setOverlay(null);
        }}
        onBack={() => setOverlay(null)}
      />
    );
  } else if (openClass) {
    screen = (
      <ClassDetailScreen
        classItem={classes.find((c) => c.id === openClass.id) || openClass}
        selectedDay={selectedDay}
        isBooked={bookedIds.includes(openClass.id)}
        isWaiting={waitlistIds.includes(openClass.id)}
        waitlistPosition={waitlistIds.indexOf(openClass.id) + 3}
        onToggleBook={toggleBook}
        onToggleWaitlist={toggleWaitlist}
        onBack={() => setOpenClass(null)}
      />
    );
  } else if (tab === "home") {
    screen = (
      <HomeScreen
        bookings={allBookings}
        onGoToProfile={() => setTab("profile")}
        onOpenBooking={(b) => {
          if (b.kind === "openbox") {
            setSelectedDay(b.day);
            setOverlay("openbox");
          } else {
            setSelectedDay(b.day);
            setOpenClass(b.classItem);
          }
        }}
        bookedClassId={bookedTodayId}
        classes={todayClasses}
        onGoToClasses={() => setTab("classes")}
        onGoToWod={() => setTab("wod")}
        onGoToProgress={() => setTab("progress")}
        onOpenBookedClass={(c) => {
          setSelectedDay(DAYS[0].date);
          setOpenClass(c);
        }}
        onOpenAnnouncement={(a) => {
          setOpenAnnouncement(a);
          setOverlay("announcement");
        }}
        onGoToAnnouncements={() => {
          setOpenAnnouncement(ANNOUNCEMENTS[0]);
          setOverlay("announcement");
        }}
        announcements={ANNOUNCEMENTS}
      />
    );
  } else if (tab === "classes") {
    screen = (
      <ClassesScreen
        selectedDay={selectedDay}
        onSelectDay={setSelectedDay}
        classes={classes}
        bookedIds={bookedIds}
        onToggleBook={toggleBook}
        onOpenClass={setOpenClass}
        onOpenBox={() => setOverlay("openbox")}
        openBoxSlots={openBoxByDay[selectedDay] || []}
      />
    );
  } else if (tab === "wod") {
    screen = (
      <WodScreen
        key={selectedDay}
        selectedDay={selectedDay}
        onSelectDay={setSelectedDay}
        myScores={myScores}
        prRecords={prRecords}
        onGoToPr={() => setTab("progress")}
        defaultShare={privacy.shareScores}
        onSaveScore={(day, entry) =>
          setMyScores((prev) => ({ ...prev, [day]: entry }))
        }
      />
    );
  } else if (tab === "progress") {
    screen = (
      <ProgressScreen
        benchmarks={benchmarks}
        setBenchmarks={setBenchmarks}
        prRecords={prRecords}
        setPrRecords={setPrRecords}
        prHistories={prHistories}
        setPrHistories={setPrHistories}
        privacy={privacy}
      />
    );
  } else {
    screen = (
      <ProfileScreen
        phone={phone}
        setPhone={setPhone}
        email={email}
        setEmail={setEmail}
        onSubviewChange={setProfileSub}
        photo={photo}
        setPhoto={setPhoto}
        notifSettings={notifSettings}
        onToggleNotif={(k) =>
          setNotifSettings((prev) => ({ ...prev, [k]: !prev[k] }))
        }
        privacy={privacy}
        onTogglePrivacy={(k) =>
          setPrivacy((prev) => ({ ...prev, [k]: !prev[k] }))
        }
        onLogout={() => {
          setProfileSub(null);
          setAuthStage('login');
          setTab('home');
        }}
      />
    );
  }

  const isDetailView = Boolean(openClass || overlay);
  let backLabel = "INDIETRO";
  if (openClass) backLabel = "CLASSES";
  else if (overlay === "openbox") backLabel = "CLASSES";
  else if (overlay === "notifications") backLabel = "INDIETRO";
  else if (overlay === "announcement") backLabel = "HOME";

  function goBack() {
    setOpenClass(null);
    setOverlay(null);
  }

  return (
    <div
      className="w-full min-h-screen bg-black flex items-center justify-center py-6"
      style={{ fontFamily: "'Montserrat', sans-serif" }}
    >
      <style>{`
        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow:wght@700;800;900&family=Montserrat:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');
        .font-display { font-family: 'Barlow', sans-serif; }
      `}</style>
      <div className="relative w-[380px] h-[780px] bg-black rounded-[2.5rem] border-4 border-neutral-800 overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
        <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 h-6 flex items-center justify-between px-7 text-[11px] text-neutral-300 z-20">
          <span>9:41</span>
          <span>●●●●</span>
        </div>
        {isDetailView && (
          <div className="absolute top-6 left-0 right-0 z-30 bg-black/95 backdrop-blur border-b border-neutral-900 px-4 py-3 flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={goBack}
              className="flex items-center gap-1 text-neutral-100"
            >
              <ChevronLeft size={22} />
              <span className="text-sm font-semibold">{backLabel}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="h-full overflow-y-auto">
          {!isDetailView && !profileSub && (
            <TopBar
              avatarSeed={USER.name[0]}
              unreadCount={notifications.filter((n) => !n.read).length}
              onBell={() => setOverlay("notifications")}
              onAvatar={() => {
                setOpenClass(null);
                setOverlay(null);
                setProfileSub(null);
                setTab("profile");
              }}
            />
          )}
          <div className={isDetailView ? "pt-16" : ""}>{screen}</div>
        </div>
        {toast && (
          <div className="absolute bottom-24 left-4 right-4 z-40 bg-neutral-100 text-black rounded-xl px-4 py-3 shadow-2xl flex items-start gap-2.5">
            <Check size={15} strokeWidth={3} className="flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
            <span className="text-[12px] font-semibold leading-snug">
              {toast}
            </span>
          </div>
        )}
        <TabBar
          active={openClass ? "classes" : tab}
          onChange={(k) => {
            setOpenClass(null);
            setOverlay(null);
            setProfileSub(null);
            setTab(k);
          }}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
